description: Architecture registration does not provide a loader for the two published FP8 variants.
trigger: Load either reference -FP8 checkpoint through the new model builder and ordinary SafetensorsCollection.
expected_behavior: A compatible loading path would decode FP8 weights using their scale tensors.
actual_behavior: Q's .weight passes name detection, but get_tensor calls convert_dtype, which raises ValueError('Unknown dtype F8_E4M3'). The .weight_scale_inv tensors are not requested.

verification.description: Compared both FP8 configurations and layer-zero headers with Attention registration order, Linear.load_fp16 and collection dtype conversion.
verification.limits: No actual load; preceding device and filesystem operations must succeed to reach this error.

introductions.rationale: Introduction of Qwen3 MoE dispatch exposes this published-checkpoint compatibility boundary; generic loader restrictions predate this architecture.
